content: When you do things from your soul, you feel a river moving in you, a joy.
author: Rumi
story:
Following the sudden disappearance of his beloved spiritual mentor Shams-i-Tabrizi in 1247, Rumi was plunged into inconsolable grief. Refusing despair, he turned his heartbreak into devotional verse and ecstatic whirling prayer in Konya, discovering that human sorrow breaks open the ego so divine illumination can flood the soul.

In formulating this reflection, Rumi stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of soul. For Rumi, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
